messageValues.message:
You are the intent classifier for Success Path Mentors (SPM), a 1-to-1 tutoring sales system.

CLASSIFICATION ONLY. Do not answer the customer, do not provide tutoring facts, and do not execute any action.

Select `spm_intent` EXACTLY from the supplied 62-intent catalog.
Use `secondary_spm_intent` only when a second distinct customer intent is clearly present; otherwise return "".
Use prior sales state only to understand a short contextual reply. Never copy unstated facts from prior state.
If a greeting is followed by a substantive request, classify the substantive request.
Do not invent an intent.
Do not extract entities in this WU; entity extraction is a separate stage.
Detect language as ar, en, or fr.
Confidence is 0..1 and represents confidence in the PRIMARY intent.
Use lower confidence when multiple intents are plausible or the message is materially ambiguous.
Never manipulate confidence to force an action.
Return exactly one JSON object, no Markdown and no extra text.

Required JSON:
{
  "spm_intent": "one exact catalog intent",
  "secondary_spm_intent": "",
  "confidence": 0.0,
  "language": "ar|en|fr",
  "rationale_code": "short_machine_readable_reason"
}

parameters.jsCode:
const j=$input.first().json || {};
const classification={
 schema:'SPM_CLASSIFIER_RESULT_V2',
 spm_intent:'',
 secondary_spm_intent:'',
 confidence:0,
 threshold:0.85,
 ambiguous:true,
 route_decision:'fallback',
 requires_clarification:false,
 allow_irreversible_action:false,
 language:j.language_hint || null,
 rationale_code:'INTENT_CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE_OR_INVALID',
 intent_id:null,category:null,required_entities:[],
 legacy_route_intent:null,legacy_next_action:null,risk_tier:null,source_gate:null,sales_stage:null,
 catalog_version:'SPM_V2_62_INTENTS',
 catalog_count:Number(j.intent_catalog_count||0),
 model_output_valid:false,
 low_confidence_rule:'NO_IRREVERSIBLE_ACTION'
};
return [{json:{...j,classification,classifier_error:{code:'WU88_CATALOG_NOT_READY',safe_to_continue:true}}}];

nodes.name: Load SPM Entity Schema V2 [READ ONLY]

messageValues.message:
You are the entity extraction engine for Success Path Mentors.

EXTRACTION ONLY. Do not answer the customer, classify intent, recommend a product, or execute any action.
Extract only values explicitly present in the CURRENT CUSTOMER MESSAGE.
Do not copy values from prior sales state unless the current message explicitly repeats or corrects them.
Do not infer timezone from country.
Do not infer diagnosis, current level, teacher characteristics, payment status, booking status, or system identifiers.
Preserve the raw form of names and PII; do not aggressively spell-correct names, email addresses, phone numbers, IDs, or transaction references.
Preserve Arabic negation. Never globally replace ة with ه.
For multiple children, return separate student_profiles; never merge grades, subjects or goals between children.
If a value appears to correct an earlier value, set correction_detected=true and include only the newly stated value.
Return raw extracted values; deterministic normalization happens after you.

Return exactly one JSON object:
{
  "entities":[{"entity":"schema entity name","raw":"explicit value","confidence":0.0}],
  "student_profiles":[{"student_ref":"child_1","student_name":"","grade":"","subjects":[],"goal":"","topic":""}],
  "correction_detected":false,
  "language":"ar|en|fr"
}

Only use entity names present in ENTITY SCHEMA. Omit unknown values. No Markdown.

parameters.jsCode:
const j=$input.first().json||{};
return [{json:{...j,entity_extraction:{schema:'SPM_ENTITY_RESULT_V2',records:[],global_entities:{},student_profiles:[],correction_detected:false,language:j.classification?.language||j.language_hint||null,raw_message_preserved:j?.message?.raw||'',timezone_not_inferred_from_country:true,status:'SAFE_FALLBACK'},entity_error:{code:'WU89_SCHEMA_OR_NORMALIZATION_NOT_READY',safe_to_continue:true}}}];
